structured_output.notes: Zero external dependencies used. Safe URL normalization and DOM element creation prevent XSS. Responsive layout adapts via CSS Grid and Flexbox across mobile and desktop displays. Accessible modals support keyboard navigation (Esc to dismiss) and focus restoration. All REST endpoints (/api/bookmarks, /api/bookmarks?q=, PATCH, DELETE) are integrated with debounced search and asynchronous feedback.
structured_output.summary: Implemented the MiniLinks web frontend in index.html, style.css, and app.js featuring a responsive bookmark manager, bookmark creation, debounced search filtering, edit modal, delete confirmation modal, and operational notification banner.
